# file_history { #crossrepo.gitutil.file_history }

```python
crossrepo.gitutil.file_history(repo, path, follow=True)
```

List every commit that changed one file, newest first.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[Location](`crossrepo.location.Location`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`), [str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Working tree to inspect, on this machine or another.

<code>[**path**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository-relative path of the file.

<code>[**follow**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Follow renames, so history reaches back past a rename. Only meaningful for a single file; pass `False` for a directory, which ``--follow`` does not describe.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[Tuple](`typing.Tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`), [str](`str`)\]\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Tuples of ``(sha, iso_date, subject)``, newest first.
